description: Sums jfb_report_safety_v2.precip_today_in for a project across every report up to and including an end date, split into month-to-date (reports on/after a caller-supplied month start) and project-to-date (every report up to end date). Only rows with precip_today_in > 0 count, matching the non-native app's fetchPrecipSums. Backs the Safety tab's read-only Precip MTD / Precip Project Total fields -- these are never stored, always derived live.
direct_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rs.precip_today_in) FILTER (WHERE r.report_date >= p_month_start), 0) AS mtd_in, COALESCE(SUM(rs.precip_today_in), 0) AS ptd_in FROM usdf.jfb_report_safety_v2 rs JOIN usdf.jfb_reports r ON r.id = rs.report_id WHERE r.project_id = p_project_id AND r.report_date <= p_end_date AND rs.precip_today_in > 0

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_month_start
parameters.description: First day of the calendar month containing the report date being viewed (caller computes this, e.g. dateISO.slice(0,7)+'-01') -- reports on/after this date count toward mtd_in.

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the range -- the report date being viewed. Every report on/before this date (project-lifetime) counts toward ptd_in.

columns.name: mtd_in
columns.description: Sum of precip_today_in (where > 0) across this project's reports dated on/after p_month_start and on/before p_end_date.

columns.name: ptd_in
columns.description: Sum of precip_today_in (where > 0) across every one of this project's reports dated on/before p_end_date.
